hindi: हे वायु, तुम्हारे जो हज़ार-हज़ार वाले रथ हैं, उनके साथ आओ, हे नियुत वाले, सोम पीने के लिए।
english: O Vāyu, those thousandfold chariots of yours: come with them, O possessor of teams, for the drinking of Soma.
notes: niyutvān taken as vocative, "possessing niyuts" (teams of horses), the word kept in the gloss without further explanation. sahasriṇaḥ "thousandfold" is literal.
lines_deva: वायो॒ ये ते॑ सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथा॑स॒स्तेभि॒रा ग॑हि । नि॒युत्वा॒न्त्सोम॑पीतये
lines_iast: vāyo̱ ye tḙ saha̱sriṇo̱ rathā̭sa̱stebhi̱rā ga̭hi | ni̱yutvā̱ntsoma̭pītaye

hindi: हे नियुत वाले वायु, आओ; यह चमकीला तुम्हारे लिए प्रस्तुत किया गया है। तुम सोम निचोड़ने वाले के घर जाओगे।
english: O Vāyu, possessor of teams, come; this bright one has been offered to you. You will go to the house of the one who presses.
notes: ayāmi read as 3 sg. aorist passive of √yam ("has been extended/offered"). The noun for "this bright one" is not stated; Soma is the natural understanding but is not supplied in the translation. Token boundaries: "vāya̱vā" = vāyo + ā, "ga̭hya̱yaṃ" = gahi + ayam.
lines_deva: नि॒युत्वा॑न् वाय॒वा ग॑ह्य॒यं शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते । गन्ता॑सि सुन्व॒तो गृ॒हम्
lines_iast: ni̱yutvā̭n vāya̱vā ga̭hya̱yaṃ śu̱kro a̭yāmi te | gantā̭si sunva̱to gṛ̱ham

hindi: हे इन्द्र और वायु, नियुत वालो, हे नरो, आओ और आज चमकीले, दूध से मिले हुए का पान करो।
english: O Indra and Vāyu, you with teams, O men, come and drink today of the bright one mixed with milk.
notes: Grammar uncertain. gavāśiraḥ (visarga lost by sandhi before indra-) is a plural or adjectival form that does not agree in number with śukrasya; niyutvataḥ is not a regular dual vocative and is taken loosely as describing the pair. The noun governed by "drink of the bright one" is not stated.
lines_deva: शु॒क्रस्या॒द्य गवा॑शिर॒ इन्द्र॑वायू नि॒युत्व॑तः । आ या॑तं॒ पिब॑तं नरा
lines_iast: śu̱krasyā̱dya gavā̭śira̱ indra̭vāyū ni̱yutva̭taḥ | ā yā̭ta̱ṃ piba̭taṃ narā

hindi: हे मित्र और वरुण, ऋत को बढ़ाने वालो, तुम दोनों के लिए यह सोम निचोड़ा गया है; यहाँ मेरी पुकार सुनो।
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, increasers of order, this Soma is pressed for you two; hear my call here.
notes: ṛta rendered "order".
lines_deva: अ॒यं वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा ।ममेदि॒ह श्रु॑तं॒ हव॑म्
lines_iast: a̱yaṃ vā̭ṃ mitrāvaruṇā su̱taḥ soma̭ ṛtāvṛdhā |mamedi̱ha śrṷta̱ṃ hava̭m

hindi: दोनों राजा, किसी से द्रोह न करने वाले, दृढ़ और सर्वोच्च, हज़ार खम्भों वाले सभा-भवन में बैठे हैं।
english: The two kings, injuring no one, sit in the firm, highest hall of a thousand pillars.
notes: rājānau is nominative dual here in sense, though "O kings" is possible. anabhidruhā is read as nominative dual ("not injuring"). sahasrasthūṇa is taken as locative sg. (-e) before āsāte. sadas is rendered "hall".
lines_deva: राजा॑ना॒वन॑भिद्रुहा ध्रु॒वे सद॑स्युत्त॒मे । स॒हस्र॑स्थूण आसाते
lines_iast: rājā̭nā̱vana̭bhidruhā dhru̱ve sada̭syutta̱me | sa̱hasra̭sthūṇa āsāte

hindi: वे दोनों सम्राट्, घृत की आहुति वाले, आदित्य, दानु के स्वामी, अकुटिल का अनुसरण करते हैं।
english: Those two sovereigns, whose libation is ghee, the Ādityas, lords of the dānu, attend upon the unswerving one.
notes: Uncertain. dānu (here left untranslated in the genitive) means a fluid or gift; anavahvaram "unswerving" has no noun expressed, so the object of sacete is unclear.
lines_deva: ता स॒म्राजा॑ घृ॒तासु॑ती आदि॒त्या दानु॑न॒स्पती॑ ।सचे॑ते॒ अन॑वह्वरम्
lines_iast: tā sa̱mrājā̭ ghṛ̱tāsṷtī ādi̱tyā dānṷna̱spatī̭ |sacḙte̱ ana̭vahvaram

hindi: हे नासत्यो, हे अश्विनो, गौओं सहित और घोड़ों सहित भली-भाँति आओ; हे घूमने वाले रुद्रो, पुरुषों के पीने योग्य के पास।
english: Come well, O Nāsatyas, Aśvins, with cows and with horses; O turning Rudras, to the drink of men.
notes: Uncertain. vartī is unclear (perhaps "turning, rolling" or a form of varti "course"); rudrā is taken as a vocative epithet of the Aśvins; nṛpāyyam is taken as "to be drunk by men" (alternatively "protecting men"). The translation of the last pāda is tentative.
lines_deva: गोम॑दू॒ षु ना॑स॒त्याश्वा॑वद्यातमश्विना । व॒र्ती रु॑द्रा नृ॒पाय्य॑म्
lines_iast: goma̭dū̱ ṣu nā̭sa̱tyāśvā̭vadyātamaśvinā | va̱rtī rṷdrā nṛ̱pāyya̭m

hindi: ताकि कोई दूर का या समीप का, बुरा बोलने वाला मरणशील शत्रु आक्रमण न करे, हे उदार धन वालो।
english: So that no mortal enemy, speaking ill, whether distant or near, may assail, O you of bounteous wealth.
notes: "na yat ... na" read as "so that not". ā-dadharṣat taken as subjunctive of the intensive/reduplicated √dhṛṣ with ā. The object ("us") is not expressed. vṛṣaṇ-vasū is uncertain: "having bull-like wealth", rendered "bounteous wealth".
lines_deva: न यत् परो॒ नान्त॑र आद॒धर्ष॑द् वृषण्वसू । दु॒:शंसो॒ मर्त्यो॑ रि॒पुः
lines_iast: na yat paro̱ nānta̭ra āda̱dharṣa̭d vṛṣaṇvasū | du̱:śaṃso̱ martyo̭ ri̱puḥ

hindi: वे तुम दोनों, हे अश्विनो, हमारे लिए पीले-भूरे रंग का दिखने वाला धन, जो विस्तृत स्थान पाने वाला है, ले आओ, हे धिष्ण्यो।
english: You two, O Aśvins, bring to us wealth tawny to behold, finding wide space, O you two Dhiṣṇyas.
notes: dhiṣṇyā is uncertain (a vocative epithet of the Aśvins, perhaps "attentive, bountiful"); kept as "Dhiṣṇyas". varivovidam "finding wide space" is literal; the sense is unclear.
lines_deva: ता न॒ आ वो॑ळहमश्विना र॒यिं पि॒शङ्ग॑संदृशम् । धिष्ण्या॑ वरिवो॒विद॑म्
lines_iast: tā na̱ ā vo̭ḻahamaśvinā ra̱yiṃ pi̱śaṅga̭saṃdṛśam | dhiṣṇyā̭ varivo̱vida̭m

hindi: निश्चय ही इन्द्र महान् भय को दूर हटाए; क्योंकि वह स्थिर और सर्वद्रष्टा है।
english: Indeed, may Indra drive away the great fear; for he is firm, the all-surveying one.
notes: abhī ṣat is unclear and is not translated. It may be abhi + a form from √sah or a different division; the translation drives away "the great fear" only. cucyavat taken as a causative aorist/subjunctive ("may he cause to move away"). vicarṣaṇi rendered "all-surveying".
lines_deva: इन्द्रो॑ अ॒ङ्ग म॒हद् भ॒यम॒भी षदप॑ चुच्यवत् । स हि स्थि॒रो विच॑र्षणिः
lines_iast: indro̭ a̱ṅga ma̱had bha̱yama̱bhī ṣadapa̭ cucyavat | sa hi sthi̱ro vica̭rṣaṇiḥ

hindi: और इन्द्र हम पर कृपालु हो; पीछे से हमारे पास हानि न पहुँचे; आगे हमारे लिए कल्याण हो।
english: And may Indra be gracious to us; may no harm reach us afterwards; may good be ahead of us.
notes: agham taken as "harm, evil".
lines_deva: इन्द्र॑श्च मृ॒ळया॑ति नो॒ न न॑: प॒श्चाद॒घं न॑शत् । भ॒द्रं भ॑वाति नः पु॒रः
lines_iast: indra̭śca mṛ̱ḻayā̭ti no̱ na na̭: pa̱ścāda̱ghaṃ na̭śat | bha̱draṃ bha̭vāti naḥ pu̱raḥ

hindi: इन्द्र सब दिशाओं से निर्भयता करे; वह शत्रुओं को जीतने वाला और सर्वद्रष्टा है।
english: May Indra make freedom from fear from all the quarters; he is the conqueror of enemies, the all-surveying one.
notes: āśā rendered "quarter" (direction).
lines_deva: इन्द्र॒ आशा॑भ्य॒स्परि॒ सर्वा॑भ्यो॒ अभ॑यं करत् । जेता॒ शत्रू॒न् विच॑र्षणिः
lines_iast: indra̱ āśā̭bhya̱spari̱ sarvā̭bhyo̱ abha̭yaṃ karat | jetā̱ śatrū̱n vica̭rṣaṇiḥ

hindi: हे सब देवो, आओ; मेरी इस पुकार को सुनो; इस बर्हि पर बैठो।
english: All gods, come; hear this call of mine; sit down on this barhis.
notes: viśve devāsaḥ rendered "all gods" (glossary). ā ... ni sīdata "sit down upon".
lines_deva: विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त शृणु॒ता म॑ इ॒मं हव॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्नि षी॑दत
lines_iast: viśvḙ devāsa̱ ā ga̭ta śṛṇu̱tā ma̭ i̱maṃ hava̭m | edaṃ ba̱rhirni ṣī̭data

hindi: यह तीखा, मधुर, उल्लास देने वाला तुम्हारे लिए है, शुनहोत्र के यज्ञों में; इस वांछनीय को पियो।
english: This sharp, sweet, exhilarating one is for you at the Śunahotra rites; drink this desirable one.
notes: The printed madhṷmā~ corresponds to Devanagari madhumāँ (madhumān before ayam, nasalised). śunahotreṣu may be the rites of the Śunahotra family (name); uncertain. The noun for "this one" is not stated.
lines_deva: ती॒व्रो वो॒ मधु॑माँ अ॒यं शु॒नहो॑त्रेषु मत्स॒रः । ए॒तं पि॑बत॒ काम्य॑म्
lines_iast: tī̱vro vo̱ madhṷmā~ a̱yaṃ śu̱naho̭treṣu matsa̱raḥ | e̱taṃ pi̭bata̱ kāmya̭m

hindi: हे देवो, जिनमें इन्द्र ज्येष्ठ है, मरुत् गण हैं और पूषन् दाता है, हे सब, मेरी पुकार सुनो।
english: O gods, with Indra as chief, with the Maruts as host, with Pūṣan as giver, all of you, hear my call.
notes: The compounds are read as bahuvrīhi. pūṣa-rātayaḥ "whose gift is Pūṣan" is an alternative.
lines_deva: इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा॒ मरु॑द्गणा॒ देवा॑स॒: पूष॑रातयः । विश्वे॒ मम॑ श्रुता॒ हव॑म्
lines_iast: indra̭jyeṣṭhā̱ marṷdgaṇā̱ devā̭sa̱: pūṣa̭rātayaḥ | viśve̱ mama̭ śrutā̱ hava̭m

hindi: हे माताओं में श्रेष्ठ, नदियों में श्रेष्ठ, देवियों में श्रेष्ठ सरस्वती, हम अप्रशंसित-से हैं; हे माता, हमें प्रशंसा दो।
english: O Sarasvatī, best of mothers, best of rivers, best of goddesses: we are like the unpraised; O mother, make praise for us.
notes: ambitame is read as superlative "best of mothers". praśastim naḥ kṛdhi rendered "make praise for us" (grant us renown).
lines_deva: अम्बि॑तमे॒ नदी॑तमे॒ देवि॑तमे॒ सर॑स्वति
अ॒प्र॒श॒स्ता इ॑व स्मसि॒ प्रश॑स्तिमम्ब नस्कृधि
lines_iast: ambi̭tame̱ nadī̭tame̱ devi̭tame̱ sara̭svati
a̱pra̱śa̱stā i̭va smasi̱ praśa̭stimamba naskṛdhi

hindi: तुममें, हे सरस्वती, देवी में, सब आयु स्थित हैं। शुनहोत्र के यज्ञों में आनन्द लो; हे देवी, हमें सन्तान प्रदान करो।
english: In you, Sarasvatī, in the goddess, all lives are established. Delight in the Śunahotra rites; O goddess, grant us offspring.
notes: didiḍḍhi is uncertain (2 sg. imperative of √diś, "show, grant"). tve ... devyām may be two locatives in apposition; āyūṃṣi rendered "lives". The Devanagari reads śritāyūṃṣi.
lines_deva: त्वे विश्वा॑ सरस्वति श्रि॒तायूं॑षि दे॒व्याम्
शु॒नहो॑त्रेषु मत्स्व प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः
lines_iast: tve viśvā̭ sarasvati śri̱tāyṷ̄ṃṣi de̱vyām
śu̱naho̭treṣu matsva pra̱jāṃ dḙvi didiḍḍhi naḥ

hindi: हे सरस्वती, इन ब्रह्म वचनों को स्वीकार करो, हे पुरस्कारों वाली; वे स्तुतियाँ जो गृत्समद लोग तुम्हें अर्पित करते हैं, हे ऋत वाली, जो देवों में प्रिय हैं।
english: Accept these sacred utterances, Sarasvatī, rich in prizes; the hymns which the Gṛtsamadas offer to you, possessing order, dear among the gods.
notes: brahma rendered "sacred utterances" (n. pl.; no priest meant). vājinīvati read as "rich in prizes" (vāja = prize); uncertain whether vājinī implies mares. gṛtsamadāḥ taken as the Gṛtsamada family, plural.
lines_deva: इ॒मा ब्रह्म॑ सरस्वति जु॒षस्व॑ वाजिनीवति
या ते॒ मन्म॑ गृत्सम॒दा ऋ॑तावरि प्रि॒या दे॒वेषु॒ जुह्व॑ति
lines_iast: i̱mā brahma̭ sarasvati ju̱ṣasva̭ vājinīvati
yā te̱ manma̭ gṛtsama̱dā ṛ̭tāvari pri̱yā de̱veṣu̱ juhva̭ti

hindi: यज्ञ के कल्याणकारी वे दोनों आगे बढ़ें; तुम दोनों को ही हम वरण करते हैं, और हवि वहन करने वाले अग्नि को।
english: May the two who bring welfare to the sacrifice go forth; you two indeed we choose here, and Agni, the carrier of oblations.
notes: Shift from third person (pretām) to second (yuvām); the two deities are not named in the verse and none is supplied. havis rendered "oblation".
lines_deva: प्रेतां॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॑ श॒म्भुवा॑ यु॒वामिदा वृ॑णीमहे । अ॒ग्निं च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नम्
lines_iast: pretā̭ṃ ya̱jñasya̭ śa̱mbhuvā̭ yu̱vāmidā vṛ̭ṇīmahe | a̱gniṃ ca̭ havya̱vāha̭nam

hindi: आज द्यावापृथिवी हमारे इस सिद्ध, द्युलोक को छूने वाले यज्ञ को देवों तक पहुँचाएँ।
english: Today may Heaven and Earth extend to the gods this sacrifice of ours, efficacious, touching heaven.
notes: dyāvā pṛthivī read as Heaven and Earth (glossary). sidhram "efficacious, going straight to the goal" is uncertain. naḥ taken as genitive "our" with yajñam.
lines_deva: द्यावा॑ नः पृथि॒वी इ॒मं सि॒ध्रम॒द्य दि॑वि॒स्पृश॑म् । य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ यच्छताम्
lines_iast: dyāvā̭ naḥ pṛthi̱vī i̱maṃ si̱dhrama̱dya di̭vi̱spṛśa̭m | ya̱jñaṃ de̱veṣṷ yacchatām

hindi: तुम दोनों की गोद में, द्रोह-रहित यज्ञ के योग्य देव आकर आज यहाँ सोम पीने के लिए बैठें।
english: May the gods, free from malice, worthy of sacrifice, come and sit in the lap of you two here today for the drinking of Soma.
notes: The two addressed are not named. upastha "lap" taken literally; "seat" is an alternative. Devanagari visarga in yajñiyāḥ is printed as a colon in the IAST.
lines_deva: आ वा॑मु॒पस्थ॑मद्रुहा दे॒वाः सी॑दन्तु य॒ज्ञिया॑: । इ॒हाद्य सोम॑पीतये
lines_iast: ā vā̭mu̱pastha̭madruhā de̱vāḥ sī̭dantu ya̱jñiyā̭: | i̱hādya soma̭pītaye
